subject: Mobile Development
title: Push Notifications as Retention Tools
description: One-minute skill: Push Notifications as Retention Tools.

hook.text: The average phone receives 46 push notifications per day. Most get ignored. Some keep you hooked.

buildup.text: Push notifications re-engage users who haven't opened the app in days or weeks.

discovery.text: Personalized notifications — by name, behavior, or timing — get 4x higher open rates.

twist.text: Over-notifying drives users to disable permissions or uninstall entirely.

climax.text: Push notifications are the most powerful retention tool — and the fastest way to lose users.

punchline.text: Notify wisely, or users will silence you forever.

quiz.question: What makes personalized push notifications more effective?
options: They reference user behavior and get 4x more opens
